Objection 1 of 5 — Brand & Awareness

Brand & Awareness

⚠️
Objection
"We haven't heard of you."
✅
AE Response
"That's actually by design — we've spent 12 years going deep in credit unions and community banks, not broad across every industry. We're the company your peers in [state/region] already trust."
→ Then name-drop 2–3 clients in their asset tier or on their core platform
Objection 2 of 5 — Competitive

Competitive Incumbent

⚠️
Objection
"We already use Glia / Vonage / Access Softek."
✅
AE Response
"Those are solid platforms for what they were built for. The key difference: they weren't built for autonomous AI resolution — they add AI on top of existing infrastructure. interface.ai is AI-native, so containment rates are 3× higher."
→ Don't trash the competitor. Reframe the architecture question.
Glia
Digital-first CX — limited voice AI autonomy
Vonage / CCaaS
Requires AI layering — multi-vendor complexity
Objection 3 of 5 — Change Management

Change Management & People

⚠️
Objection
"Our staff is worried AI will replace their jobs."
✅
AE Response
"We have never deployed at a CU where headcount went down because of AI. What changes is the mix of work — agents stop handling high-volume routine calls and start handling complex, relationship-sensitive ones. Member satisfaction goes up. Agent burnout goes down."
→ Invite their team lead to the next call. Don't defend — address it together.
Objection 4 of 5 — Timing

Timing & Readiness

⚠️
Objection
"We're not ready — we need to finish our core conversion first."
✅
AE Response
"That's actually ideal timing. Core conversions take 12–24 months. If we start scoping now, you're ready to deploy on day one post-conversion — instead of adding another 6–12 month AI project on top."
→ "The CUs winning the next 5 years started AI planning during their core transition."
Objection 5 of 5 — Technical / Compliance

PII & Hallucination Risk

⚠️
Objection
"What about PII protection and hallucination risk?"
✅
AE Response
"We're FI-native — same regulatory scrutiny as you. No member data trains shared models. SOC 2 and FFIEC compliant. For transactions like loan apps and fraud refunds, our AI operates in deterministic workflows — not open-ended chat.
"The AI cannot freestyle a fraud refund." — Use this line. It lands every time.
